content.thinking: Hmm, no output yet and no processes? Let me check if the log file exists and if the process is running. `ps` might not be available. Let me check the log file existence and whether python processes are running via /proc.

arguments.command: ls -la /workspace/tmp/verify1.log 2>&1; ls /proc | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' | while read p; do c=$(tr '\0' ' ' < /proc/$p/cmdline 2>/dev/null); case "$c" in *run_verify*) echo "$p $c";; esac; done
